basis_note: Eleonora's rulings of 14 October 2026 on PR #50 (options (a) and (i), then the middle option): other depository institutions are a labelled fixed share of H.4.1 reserves; the rest is split across the three groups by their H.8 cash-asset shares, first print, unanchored and an approximation. Cash assets are not reserves alone.
break_note: `h8_break_week` is true at a week where the H.8 restates the large and small panels (docs/research/h8-group-moves.json); levels across it are on different panels.
other_share_source: Median of the residual 'other depository institutions' divided by H.4.1 reserves over the 211 H.8 weeks from 2022-08-10 to 2026-08-19 on which the retired anchored build (latest-filed Call Report RC-A item 0090, moved by the H.8 and with the break refusal switched off) could be computed: median 0.0862, range -0.009 to 0.163 (docs/research/rca-fed-balances-due-diligence.md, section 7). A full-sample constant from latest-filed data, so a retrospective calibration, not point-in-time; the value is rounded to 0.086 and is Eleonora's to confirm or replace.
small_domestic_caveat: Answer 17(a): cash assets overstate small domestic banks' reserves (vault cash and correspondent balances), and balances due from other depository institutions double-count, so the groups must not be summed naively; the residual absorbs every difference and is not a measure of anything on its own (docs/stages/group-reserves.md).
units: billions of US dollars, not seasonally adjusted (H.8) and week average (H.4.1 WRESBAL)
use_note: Nothing scored or registered uses this series (her ruling of 15 October 2026, condition 3). The Call Report switch (step 2 of her ruling of 14 October 2026, once the CDR archive #49 has first prints) replaces the fixed share first.
